test_title: PYST 36: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'ICE’ is coded as '20' and 'HOT' is coded as '46'. How will' POT' be coded in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

**Logic:- Addition of all letters + 3 = Code.**

'ICE’ is coded as '20'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94a91e17c77cbc31ac9f75f2769874f32f6ef4135cf147028eb0b1b0c3cfc16b.png] 

And,

'HOT' is coded as '46'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47e466a5a8894889eedc44fdc4cc0e2f3e971310f383307b5c7a16a4c23231d3.png] 

Similarly,

'POT' is coded as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51afda5308e11cc76695d187aad452e8b042401867a8e7b62043708149a1a8b3.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"54".**
